description: Find a Costco warehouse number by city name and/or US state (name or two-letter code). Each result has the warehouse number, city, state, its page on this site and how fresh its deals are. There is no zip code search; use the city name. The warehouse number is also printed on the receipt.

q.description: Part of the city name, at least 2 letters, e.g. tigard.

state.description: A US state name or its two-letter code, e.g. OR.

name: find_warehouse
title: Find a Costco warehouse number
